description: k87: a config error naming a source whose name holds an escape sequence, a bell, a bidi override and a newline – not valid (k95), found before the source's unknown key. Through the CLI, exit 2 each, the name escaped on every stream, nothing raw, nothing written: sync's report on stderr (text, or JSON with --json), check's one stderr line (with --json too), status's report on stdout (text, or JSON with --json).
